If **shot size or spatial position** changes, describe how these transitions occur clearly, specifying both the **initial and final states**.

Numerous dark, irregular oval shadows are scattered across the ground around the figures. Initially, two figures, one in a green garment and another in dark clothing, are positioned at the center of the frame, their forms casting large, dark shadows that stretch across the uneven surface. By the end of the video, the character in dark clothing remains at the center, while the character in green clothing shifts slightly to the left of the center.**

Please note that the video features **salient human subjects**, so you should focus on describing the spatial framing and movements of them.
